status: preregistered before tests, systems measurement, or quality
scientific_question: Can sub-1%-state algorithmic spectral phases provide the broad full-rank frame motion that four Householder correction planes could not?

causal_basis.deduction: the reflector coordinates trained and opened, but rank(P-I)<=4 per side; replace the low-rank frame delta with a basis-free global transform whose departure from identity can move 766 real Fourier directions

frozen_mechanism.gauge: checkpoint-free layer-specific signed permutation conjugates an exact real orthogonal FFT phase transform
frozen_mechanism.live_path: input and output phase frames are algebraically folded into shared matrix views; token activations use two dense GEMMs only
frozen_mechanism.initialization: input atoms use GPT c_fc std 0.02; output atoms are variance-corrected from width 3072 to width 353
frozen_mechanism.optimizer: Muon for the two shared matrices and AdamW for phases and gains

accounting.folding: two differentiable real FFT phase transforms over shared weight rows per layer call; batch-independent and charged by exact systems measurement

gates.state_and_replay: exact and no dense MLP tensor, dense shadow, PCA basis, ambient code, persistent permutation/sign, materialized transform, or duplicated shared state
gates.functional_equivalence: folded live function and all compact gradients equal explicit activation-space spectral frames
gates.geometry: zero phase is identity; nonzero frame is real and orthogonal; departure from identity reaches rank 766 at width 768
gates.gradient: all live coordinates finite and nonzero; input/output phase gradients are noncollapsed across layers

forbidden: width, phase count, seed, LR, optimizer, gain, gauge, or initialization sweeps
